description: A strip of smooth hardwood, often boxwood, drawn along the cover between the bands to press the leather down firmly in the panels and to rub out cord marks left by tying up.
name: band stick

source_ref.label: Douglas Cockerell, Bookbinding and the Care of Books (1902), Chapter XII, p.152. Internet Archive.
